Home / About

Built on-site, run by the people who pour the floor.

KC Flooring Services is based in Baddi, Himachal Pradesh, serving the region's factories, warehouses and homes.

OUR STORY

A Baddi-based flooring contractor, owner-supervised on every job.

Baddi sits at the centre of Himachal Pradesh's pharmaceutical and manufacturing belt, where floors have to survive forklifts, chemical spills and round-the-clock shifts. KC Flooring Services was set up to serve exactly that: industrial-grade epoxy, PU and ESD flooring, alongside the waterproofing and coating work that protects a building from the ground up.

Every job — from a single car-parking bay to a full factory floor — is supervised directly by the owners, not passed off to an unnamed site team.

HOW WE WORK

From site visit to handover.

01

Site visit & assessment

We inspect the existing surface, note traffic levels and chemical exposure, and measure the area before quoting.

02

Surface preparation

Grinding, crack repair and priming so the coating bonds properly — most flooring failures start here, so we don't rush it.

03

Application

Epoxy, PU, terrazzo or coating applied in controlled layers, with film thickness checked as we go.

04

Curing & quality check

Floors are left to cure fully before handover, with a final check for gloss, levelness and adhesion.

05

Handover & aftercare

We walk you through cleaning and maintenance so the finish lasts as long as it's designed to.

WHAT WE VALUE

Three things every job is judged on.

Proper prep, every time

No coating goes down over a surface that hasn't been ground, cleaned and primed correctly.

Clear, written quotes

GST-billed quotes that state area, materials and finish, so there's no ambiguity at handover.

Owners on site

Maheshwar and Anil are directly reachable through the job — not a rotating site team.
